description: Ready-to-use residential or mobile proxy lines for the signed-in AeonProxy account, with the proxy login and password in them: country, region, city and ISP (residential) or carrier (mobile) targeting, rotating (a new IP for every connection) or sticky sessions of 1 minute to 6 hours, HTTP or SOCKS5, up to 100 lines. Region, city, isp and carrier take the names list_proxy_locations returns. Making lines is free; traffic is counted only when they are used.

country.description: two-letter country code; leave out for any country

product.description: residential (home IPs) or mobile (4G/5G carrier IPs)

session.description: sticky keeps one IP for session_minutes; rotating gives a new IP per connection

name: generate_proxy_lines
title: Generate proxy lines
